notes.title: 1.28.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We've added some new items to make building levels even more fun!

Elemental Snowmen and Skeletons are immune to elements based on their type. We've also added speed settings to all enemies so you can decide how fast or slow they move.

Elemental mushrooms can freeze, burn, poison, or charm whatever destroys them. These are a great way to create one-off elemental effects in your levels.

Engines now have material variants for even more possibilities.

Happy Hopping!

You'll also notice Goats and Snowmen have had their art improved, we hope you like the new look!

We've also fixed a few bugs:
[list]
[*] Linked platforms getting separated sometimes
[*] Crown power not taking effect before first move
[*] Skeletons hopping gaps between land sometimes
[/list]
Happy Hopping!

notes.title: Welcome to round 11 of our community level contest!
notes.notes:
[b]Prizes:[/b]
1st: 2,000 💎 
2nd: 1,000 💎 
3rd: 500 💎  

Two free rabbits will also be given out: Royal Ruby #11 (donated by CleanShirt) for the best use of the Extra Credit assignment as chosen by contest mods and Sky #55 (donated by xove) as a random drawing for anyone who submits a level. 

This round, the theme is Some Bunny Loves You. Have you ever fallen for someone who just wasn’t interested in you? Maybe they even actively disliked you? Wouldn’t it be great if you could give them a magic love potion? Your challenge this round is to make a partner level using a goat that dislikes you (no charmed goat). You and the goat should be separated by water, and the goat must be used to finish the level. For a Valentine’s Day twist, the goat must “fall in love” with you (become charmed) by the end, and you must both exit the level.

Extra Credit: Use the decor in your level to create a candy heart message (BE MINE, IGOTU BABE, XOXO, etc.) We want the words - it doesn’t have to be heart shaped. Most clever, creative, and related will win!

- All piece types are allowed.
- The entire build area is allowed
- All themes are allowed.
- One uncharmed goat must be included.
- Level must include “R11” in title.
- Only Verified Discord users may enter

notes.title: Ice wall, new decorations, new rabbits #30
notes.notes:
King Rabbit has been updated!

We hope you enjoy the new ice wall, the new decorations, and the new rabbits. We're excited to see what you will build. We've also added two new settings "screen shake" and "battery save mode" which can be toggled on or off in the settings menu under "performance". 

It's time for us to shift more of our energy into the new game. The new game will take place in the same King Rabbit universe, but will have a different gameplay. We plan to release the new game in 2021. All of your purchases / rabbits will be transferrable to the new game if you have created an account with us. We'll continue to update King Rabbit, but if you notice a slowing down it's because we're building the new game.

We also plan to add a new theme, but this is a big undertaking and will take some time to build out. Thank you for being a part of this community and supporting our small studio!

Stay healthy and warm this holiday season.

Happy hopping,
Brian & Austin

notes.title: Rabbit market is available NOW! #27
notes.notes:
The much anticipated rabbit market lets you buy and sell rabbits for gems or gold, directly from other players! This is the beginning of a real, player-driven economy for King Rabbit. 

This allows you to sell the skins you are no longer interested in, in order to buy something new. Players will now be able to purchase the old sold out rabbits.

Rabbits you have for sale will be in listed in the market, as well as in your player profile. This is an above-and-beyond way to "support" your favorite builders and friends by buying their rabbits directly.

Happy hopping!
RareSloth

P.S. Update will be available soon on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.raresloth.android.kr2]Android[/url] and [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/king-rabbit/id1440480754]iOS[/url].

notes.title: Rabbit Market coming soon!
notes.notes:
The much anticipated rabbit market lets you buy and sell rabbits for gems or gold, directly from other players!

This allows you to sell the skins you are no longer interested in, in order to buy something new. Players will now be able to purchase the old sold out rabbits, if the owners are willing to sell them of course!

Rabbits you have for sale will be in listed in the market, as well as in your player profile (see screenshot). This is a good way to "support" to your favorite builders and friends by buying their rabbits directly.

A healthy economy needs a sink to prevent runaway inflation, 15% of every rabbit trade will disappear from the game. This may or may not fluctuate in the future.

You can also engage in a meta-game of “flipping” rabbits for a profit. No guarantees though, trade at your own risk! Due to the limited nature of rabbits, we expect this update to make buying rabbits more competitive.

Expect the update by early September.

Happy hopping!

notes.title: New music, localizations, filters, settings, notifications #21
notes.notes:
After years of re-building King Rabbit we are finally nearing the big release on iOS and Android. In a way, this is only the beginning as we plan to continue updating King Rabbit for many years. 

It has been a long journey and a lot of effort from both of us to get to this point. We thank everyone who has been a part of our journey and offered words of encouragement, positive reviews, and financial support via in-game purchases. 

After years of living very frugally in order to create this game, we are optimistic the mobile release will provide us with a foundation to grow the business. If things go well with this mobile release, we will be financially able to hire our first employees and invest more to improve the King Rabbit service. 

We invite you to [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/king-rabbit/id1440480754]pre-order on iOS[/url] (free). 

Thank you!
Brian & Austin

notes.title: Kingdom and Realms update! #16
notes.notes:
To make the campaign more engaging, we’ve created the “Kingdom” and “Realms” that you can explore. We hope you enjoy this new campaign structure! :)

[b]KINGDOM[/b]

The kingdom is the central location or “home” that ties the game together. Within the Kingdom there are different realms that you can access.

[b]REALMS[/b]

Each realm contains three portals. Each portal contains 10 levels, the last level has a portal gem. To complete the realm, you must find the portal gem! For the completionist types, if you find all of the gold in a portal - there will be a gold border surrounding the portal gem. 

Currently we offer two realms; [b]Garden[/b] and [b]Community[/b]. Over time we will continue to add new realms for you to explore.

[b]NEW LEVEL FILTERS[/b]

Portals for "best", "puzzle", and "Action" can now be found in the community realm. Best levels are determined by community feedback and an algorithm.

[b]EXPANSIONS REFUNDED[/b]

Previously, we were selling packs of the “best” levels for gems under the name "pink diamond expansion". Anyone who purchased the expansion has been refunded. We will no longer be selling packs, but instead giving away for free! 

Let us know what you think in the comments! <3

[b]OTHER STUFF[/b]

* Snowmen charge 2 tiles now
* Art updated for several items
* Ice crown now allows rabbit to walk on ice without slipping
* Fire and element pit particles updated
* Items float higher making them easier to see behind walls
* Themed walls are back

notes.title: Bomb crown, turret, shield, and more! #15
notes.notes:
[b]Bomb Crowns[/b]
Pick up the bomb crown and burst through walls, trees, enemies, and anything breakable. While wearing this crown you are immune to explosions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33785229/4d12d9b1b21985c6d96e49c159ce8bfb7f0603b8.gif[/img]

[b]Bomb Turrets[/b]
Shoots mini bombs, causing anything it touches to explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33785229/e67ffecbfdb101b9a6f3c060ec6c7f4a5fc9955e.gif[/img]

[b]Shield Wall[/b]
Protect anything inside of it. Shields can be switched on and off using switches for a deeper puzzle experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33785229/dc4ea9cb789473b1ac35accc5d37fc43b7e94ccb.gif[/img]

[b]Portals[/b]
This is the new end goal for levels. This is in preparation for the future realm campaign update. This removes the cage & key requirement for building levels making building a little easier for new builders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33785229/3cb119b492701eaa12d9da5dd4ed1fe3008fee0e.gif[/img]

[b]Colored rabbit holes[/b]
Rabbit hole pairs are now color coded. Less guess-and-check, more fun. There's a limit of 6 pairs of rabbit holes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33785229/eda879ba07f0c8c695361cec224386cab8c41262.gif[/img]

Let us know what you think in the comments below!

Happy hopping,

Brian & Austin
RareSloth

notes.title: Winterland theme, ice, snowmen #9
notes.notes:
[b]ICE GROUND, BREAKABLE GROUND[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/4c3b3f4b1b5ceb9f3805377fd19f51216cce6a41.gif[/img]

[b]SNOWMEN[/b]

They're big grumpy bullies that will try to push you off the levels, or squish you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/f4f4a70fc62b538dca4000f72fa107578ca08700.gif[/img]

[b]EXPANSIONS COMING SOON! EARN GEMS![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/a38e965972e65da64a7ae4abffb1134af71d020a.png[/img]

Attention all builders, we have some VERY exciting news for you!

Would you like to earn gems for your levels to buy rabbits and other IAP? [b]Starting now[/b], we will be selecting high quality levels from the community to be featured in expansion packs. If your level is of high quality and is selected for an expansion, you will earn a percentage of every sale in gems. This is a way for builders to be recognized by the community while earning premium currency!

The first 100 sales of each expansion will include a limited edition rabbit. Players who purchase expansions can feel good knowing their purchases are supporting the builders directly. They get better content to play, AND rare rabbits that will be exchangeable in the future. Limit one expansion purchase per account.

This helps RareSloth free up time spent building levels to focus on making the game better and adding new features and content. RareSloth will keep a percentage of each expansion sale.

We feel this is a win - win - win for players, builders, and RareSloth.

Questions, concerns, feedback? Post in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/kingrabbit]Discord[/url]

[b]OTHER STUFF[/b]

* Added brick wall as requested by players
* Rabbits sleep now when going AFK
* Blood splatter is less splattery
* Fixed celebrate animation body disappearing
* Updated destroy decals for wood, metal, stone objects
* Fixed diagonal movement bug
* Fixed "charmed" "frozen" text not showing up sometimes
* Fixed rare death when running into piston
* Fixed spectate mode showing wrong rabbits

notes.title: Visible container objects, rabbit cuteness #8
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/1d5d0cf922766e67a796df2f8483a4d50a5515f5.png[/img]
[b]CONTAINER OBJECTS[/b]

All item contents are now visible during gameplay, this is a subtle but major change to the gameplay. Now you don't have to guess and check what's inside objects - with more information there's more focus on solving the puzzle. This saves you time and demystifies some levels (especially large community ones). 

With this change, some levels were broken and will need to be re-published. If your level was unpublished your gold has been returned to you but unfortunately the stats will have to be reset. Right now our player base is small, so don't worry too much about your stats until we start ramping up and releasing on multiple platforms.

[b]CUTER RABBIT[/b]

Several players said the [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/king-rabbit-classic/id1073389796]King Rabbit - Classic[/url] rabbit was more cute. We've listened to your feedback. Rabbits now have rounder heads and cuter eyes. Also, rabbits now fall asleep when you go AFK for several seconds.

[b]FASTER RABBIT[/b]

We received feedback that the rabbit felt unresponsive sometimes. This is because during the rabbit's stun animation you wouldn't be able to move but the move would still be queued up. It's better now, getting stunned won't prevent you from moving and you can now move much faster.

Happy hopping!
Brian & Austin

notes.title: Limited edition rabbits coming soon... #7
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/7e918f356ca21a703162abc3e7a9739f546586c7.png[/img]

The update coming this Monday is special, that's why we're posting this announcement a few days ahead of time. On Monday you will be able to purchase limited edition rabbits. Only 100 of every rabbit will ever be available. Each rabbit includes an ID from [b]#1[/b] to [b]#100[/b]. The ID you get upon purchasing a rabbit will be randomly chosen from the remaining ID’s.

[b]Why should I buy a rabbit?[/b]
Once they’re gone, they’re gone. As the player base grows and expands onto other platforms like console and mobile, getting rabbits will become increasingly competitive. It’s early now and competition isn’t so fierce. Buying a rabbit now could be a good investment. 😉

[b]Where will my rabbit be seen by other players?[/b]
When players play your levels, they will see your “rabbitar” at the top of the screen. In future updates, we will be introducing more social / multiplayer features where you can show off your rabbit in style.

[b]How do I get a rabbit?[/b]
Currently the only way to obtain a rabbit is to buy one with premium currency in the rabbit tab.

[b]Can I sell my rabbits?[/b]
Yes, in the future we will be adding features to sell your characters. In other words, your assets will not be locked to your account like other games (i.e. Hearthstone).

[b]I had claimed a founders rabbit before, where is it?[/b]
If you were one of the earliest adopters and you previously claimed your founders rabbit, you’ll see it now in your account’s rabbit tab.

[b]Any other questions?[/b]
Ask away in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/PVezFVb]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Underworld theme, goats, elemental pits! #6
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/7af5f873e4a1b0e24865b2243590e20e36197063.gif[/img]

King Rabbit just got a little better, this is a pretty big update. <3

[b]UNDERWORLD THEME![/b]

You can now build using the underworld theme! Just click the theme icon within the level builder. The underworld has some differences in mechanics; metal objects float in lava while wooden objects burn up on contact. If you change your level’s theme you’ll have to revalidate it. 

[b]GOATS![/b]

Goats have replaced the reaper character. They behave similarly, following you around and trying to swing their weapon at you. We felt that the goat was more consistent with the King Rabbit universe. Four elemental goats have been added. Elemental goats have immunities to an element just like the rabbit when wielding a crown.

[b]COMPLETION REWARDS[/b]

Now you get a small reward for completing level packs. If you’ve already beaten the level packs you can go and claim your gifts now! Your campaign progress is now visible when you complete a level. Possible rewards include gold and hints, more reward types to be added at a later time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/18a9ede31140de792dd88246a25da4e1997c693d.gif[/img]

[b]ELEMENT PITS[/b]

These are basically “fire pits” that come in 4 different elements; fire, ice, poison, and charm. Any projectiles passing over the element pit will be immediately converted to the element of that pit.

[b]OTHER STUFF[/b]

* Charm turret variation added
* Changing similar item type in builder is easier now
* Tree art and animations tweaked
* Some campaign levels tweaked to be a tad easier
* King Rabbit art and animations tweaked
* Key colors tweaked
* Locked crate art tweaked
* Frozen characters are now enveloped in an ice cube
* Ash decals added
* Dead goat decals added
* Fixed rabbit hole recoiling from saw when teleporting through
* Preventing “q” from activating quit menu when typing into text field
* Charmed goats roam instead of standing still
* Added bugs!
* Key helper-bubble added for locked crates and rabbit cage
* Tweaked container item particle
* Fixed ability to place more than limited quantity of item with ctrl+click
* Fixed cage key not dithering correctly in builder toolbox
* Fixed crate floating in air when pushing reaper holding it into water
* Fixed message display position on wood walls
* Fixed vanish animations not vanishing properly
* Saw art tweaked

notes.title: Controller support, WASD, Levels! #3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33785229/fa0f8e4231e5d35ce2379f4a3aa4608157bcb4c2.gif[/img]

We underestimated the demand for controller support! Had we known better we would have had it ready in the first version. Controllers are now supported for everything except the level builder. Controller support for the builder will be added eventually, thank you for your patience.

[b]WASD SUPPORT[/b]
Now you can play more comfortably with WASD, thank you for bringing this to our attention. Sorry for not thinking about you lefties out there!

[b]10 NEW LEVELS[/b]
We’ve added 10 more levels to the tutorial. Its becoming more like a campaign than a tutorial :). We’ll keep iterating and adding levels, we’re aware of the difficulty gap between our levels and the community levels.

[b]RABBIT HOLE ITEM (coming soon)[/b]
We will push a small update soon with the rabbit hole item. Classic players will be familiar with this item, it’s been a staple in the King Rabbit world. More information on this when we release the update.

[b]RABBIT SKINS (coming soon)[/b]
Rabbit skins will be added at the end of April. Rabbit skins will be VERY scarce! Only 100 of each unique rabbit skin will be sold worldwide. Each rabbit will have a unique ID like baseball cards. If you purchase a rabbit, the ID you get will be randomly chosen from the available remaining numbers. 00-99. Because these rabbits will be so scarce they will be sold for real money, they are too good to give away. 

[b]THANK YOU FOR YOUR FEEDBACK![/b]
A warm thank you to everyone who sent us feedback via email. We read all feedback and have already addressed a few things, like turning blood off by default. Leave your feedback below if you have any thoughts.

[b]OTHER LITTLE THINGS[/b][list]
[*] Brick wall has been replaced by wooden wall for consistency (it burns)
[*] Tree art updated
[*] Metal wall art updated
[*] Interface color changes and tweaks
[*] Added console and hotkey badges on buttons
[*] Added space hotkey to go to next level
[*] Logging out and quitting is now easier
[*] Hiding mouse cursor when moving in game
[*] Bone debris removed
[*] Blood is now off by default (toggle in settings)
[*] Fixed cap on level name length to 24
[*] Fixed crate not catching fire when crate on top gets hit with fire
[*] Fixed crate not staying down when moving on top
[*] Fixed performance of many reapers in level
[*] Fixed reaper movement bugs
[*] Fixed rabbit not fully burning while wearing crowns
[/list]

notes.title: King Rabbit first release! #1
notes.notes:
Welcome players,

You're an early adopter, and we really appreciate you! Thank you for being here. We will continue to update King Rabbit regularly. The best way for you to provide feedback is to post in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/PVezFVb]Discord[/url]!

Up next is a level builder update! This will include:
[list]
[*] Better statistics for the levels you build
[*] Replays of players playing your levels
[*] Builder polish and improvements
[/list]
King Rabbit is far from perfect but our long term goal is to make this one of the best puzzle experiences in the world. Thank you for your patience, support, and feedback.
